title: Wai adapter: import .wai artifacts as events
description: Read .wai/projects/*/{research,designs,plans,handoffs}/*.md and emit capture events with provenance links. Red: fixture repo with known wai artifacts -> expected event set. Green: adapter impl. Maps to MVP1 'import existing wai artifacts'.

title: Define kaya.event/v0 event schema + parser
description: Core event format: id, schema, type, timestamp, actor, project, subject, data, provenance, artifacts. Red: parser round-trip tests incl. rejection of malformed events (missing timestamp, unknown schema version). Green: serde types + validator. Refactor: dedupe by (type, subject, provenance) per design.

title: Scaffold Rust CLI crate (kaya init/status skeleton)
description: Cargo crate with clap CLI. Red: integration test asserting 'kaya init' creates .kaya/ ledger dir and 'kaya status' reports ledger path. Green: minimal impl. Refactor: genesis-style structured envelope output (see dont/genesis precedents).

title: Experiment report projection with authored preservation
description: Generate experiment report (question, hypothesis, runs, observations, findings) mixing derived + authored sections per docs/src/index.md ownership modes. Red: authored text survives regeneration even when ledger changed; flag stale authored sections whose evidence changed. MVP1 closure: dossier from existing project info without rewriting anything.

title: Research index projection (generated managed block)
description: Project Question/Hypothesis/Experiment/Run/Finding graph into a research index. Red: golden-file test for generated section between kaya:begin/end markers; authored sections outside blocks must be untouched. Green: deterministic generator. Refactor: incremental recompute.

title: Git + test-runner passive capture adapters
description: Git: commits/tags -> events (git2 or CLI parse). Test runner: cargo test JSON output -> run-completed observations. Red: fixture-driven tests first. Maps to MVP1 'import git history and test results'.

title: Add kaya to ddl managed-tools registry
description: PR in charly-vibes/dulce-de-leche: add kaya to catalog + README MANAGED-TOOLS block (drift test enforces) once kaya is installable. GitHub topics charly-vibes+dulce-de-leche already set on this repo.

title: CI: just ci + ci.yml workflow per fleet standard
description: Once crate lands: justfile with ci recipe (fmt, clippy -D warnings, test), single ci.yml job 'Test & Build' timeout 10 running just ci. versions.ddl.toml already pinned by ddl init. Release.yml deferred to first tag (five-target matrix per standardization doc section 1).
